description: Random Forest input features computed on the ESP32 (firmware 4.x) and sent in telemetry schema 2.x. The same names are used in the database, training datasets and live inference.

features.name: soil_moisture
features.description: Normalized soil moisture from fixed endpoints dry=4090, wet=921 ADC counts

features.name: soil_rate_per_min
features.description: Least-squares slope of soil moisture over the last 30 s

features.name: soil_std_30s
features.description: Standard deviation of soil moisture over the last 30 s

features.name: water_wetness
features.description: Relative water exposure index from fixed endpoints dry=0, wet=1725 ADC counts (not rainfall intensity)

features.name: water_mean_30s
features.description: Mean water wetness over the last 30 s

features.name: tilt_deg
features.description: Angle between the current and the session-baseline gravity vectors (orientation change, not ground displacement)

features.name: tilt_rate_deg_per_min
features.description: Least-squares slope of relative tilt over the last 10 s

features.name: accel_dyn_g
features.description: Standard deviation of acceleration magnitude over the upload interval (50 Hz samples)

features.name: gyro_mag_dps
features.description: RMS bias-corrected angular rate magnitude over the upload interval

features.name: vib_events_per_s
features.description: SW-420 filtered pulse events per second over the upload interval (20 ms dead time); not vibration amplitude or frequency

features.name: vib_above_bg_per_s
features.description: Filtered event rate above the background rate measured during calibration (floored at 0)

features.name: vib_events_30s
features.description: Filtered SW-420 events in the last 30 s
